orders.text:
CLR No. 84 of 2018 
Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Lokendra Dobhal, Advocate 
for the revisionist. 
Issue notice to the respondent 
by registered post, acknowledgment 
due, returnable at an early date. 
In addition to normal mode of 
service, revisionist is permitted to 
serve personally upon the 
respondent. 
Steps to be taken within three 
days. 
List after service report is 
received. 
Having heard learned counsel 
for the revisionist, as an interim 
measure, it is directed that if an 
application for adjournment is moved 
on behalf of the revisionist before the 
Trial Court, the same shall be 
considered favourably only for a 
period of three weeks. 
List alongwith connected Civil 
Revision No. 69 of 2018. 
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.) 02.08.2018
Nahid

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CLR No.84 of 2018
With
CLR No.69 of 2018
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Lokendra Dobhal, Advocate for the 
revisionist.
Ms. Akleem Parveen, Advocate holding brief 
of Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate for the respondent in 
CLR No.69 of 2018. 
The revisionist herein has filed the 
substitution application, bringing on record, the 
heirs of the deceased-respondent, who had met with 
the sad demise on 23.08.2019. The Registry has 
reported that the substitution application, is delayed 
by one day. An oral request has been made by the 
counsel for the petitioner for condonation of one 
day’s delay, which has chanced in filing the 
substitution application, which is not being 
seriously opposed by the respondent’s counsel. The 
same would stand accepted and condoned. 
Accordingly, the Substitution Application 
No.15761 of 2019, too which has been preferred by 
the revisionist would stand allowed. Petitioner is 
permitted to carry out the necessary amendment, in 
both the revisions, in the cause title of the revisions 
by bringing the heirs on record of the deceased￾respondent within a period of ten days from today. 
List this revision immediately after ten days.
Interim orders dated 02.08.2018 passed in 
CLR No.84 of 2018 and 26.06.2018 passed in CLR 
No.69 of 2018 would remain extended till the next 
date of listing. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 18.03.2021
